meta.title: 按授权范围读取事实，经统一语义归类与配对渲染多视角观测
meta.description: GET /api/tasks/:id/observation is a read-only task-truth projection. It uses the same complete projectKey/mode/taskId scope as semantic reads, takes admissions and committed public output from the selected project/mode Journal, and attaches Agent activity from the same scope. The query scope remains an observation subtree and node remains a selected observation node.
meta.prototypeBoundary: docs/ui/semantic-observation-tour.html is a standalone semantic Mock design; it does not consume or prove this production chain
meta.browserDesignContract: Delivered browser modules use owner-local callbacks and subscriptions rather than a global event bus. runtime-shell.js mounts the shared semantic panel, retains its lifecycle and revision guards, and applies display preferences through a display-preferences.js subscription with dispose on teardown. semantic-observation.js emits view intent callbacks; task-dashboard.js and observation.js own pagehide disposal. Task Dashboard and Pipeline Observation are the delivered four-mode preference surfaces. Other shared shell pages intentionally omit that surface. This declaration does not claim every future UI view is delivered.
meta.payloadReferenceStatus: Delivered browser-side shared-reference contract: runtime-api.js freezeJsonValue recursively freezes accepted JSON in place and createRuntimeReadPublication publishes one frozen content reference per scope/revision. runtime-shell.js decodes semantic GET once and each SSE message once, then shares the accepted envelope across retained views. Same-scope refresh failure retains the prior confirmed reference and marks it stale; newer scope or request serials reject late values. Existing executable evidence includes the unguarded shared-payload mutation RED and installed GET/SSE receipts. This is a same-process browser contract, not proof of a cross-process native Arc<T>; no Rust UI boundary exists in this graph.
meta.agentActivityContract: For the selected task scope, Runtime consumes already owner-decoded native allocations, active turns, resumed segments, child invocation and delivery, milestone reviews, Planner records, and unavailable sources. Event normalization and role frames never generate or replace instance identity. actualExecutionGraph is a candidate read-only field of the same successful projection.
meta.agentActivityOwner: packages/runtime/src/observation/agent-activity.ts owns pure selection of typed activity facts; packages/app/src/ui-runtime/agent-activity-read.ts decodes existing owners and assembles their already-read sources; packages/contracts/src/actual-execution-graph.ts carries the source snapshot; packages/ui/projection/actual-execution-graph.ts projects presentation for docs/ui rendering without control effects. Assignment-graph fact replay is not a prerequisite. Runtime behavior remains UNVERIFIED for this candidate design.
meta.actualExecutionGraphContract: The existing RuntimeAgentActivityProjection value remains the only read carrier. Its successful value carries actualExecutionGraph from a Runtime pure selector over the same selected task scope's decoded native allocation, active-turn, resumed-segment, child invocation and delivery, review, and Planner records. The contracts source reaches UI presentation through existing projection. No new Journal protocol, graph-fact prerequisite, endpoint, sibling top-level carrier, Manager creation, acquire, rebind, or write occurs on GET.
meta.actualExecutionGraphHistory: Missing, unavailable, and not-recorded native sources remain explicit rather than becoming a fabricated empty history. Records whose exact relations are absent remain ungrouped and visible. Guidance, current plan, and recorded actual instances remain separate meanings; role names, timestamps, assignment membership, child context, technical instance IDs, and commit refs are not converted into execution dependencies or default labels.
meta.taskTemplateSkeletonContract: The committed TaskFlowBinding resolves a static read-only TaskFlowGuidance in load_task_truth. Guidance now carries typed template stages, mandatory stage dependencies, layout mode, and logical loop guidance. It travels inside the existing task_projection upstream payload through project_semantic_views to browser_view; it adds no node, edge, graph or HTTP path. Cyclic turn-iteration and inspection occurrence-repetition stay guidance metadata, never cyclic edges in this read DAG. Guidance remains a separate meaning from the current plan and recorded actual instances; legacy tasks without a binding keep guidance absent.
meta.i2HistoryContract: Six I2 read contracts (inspection occurrences, inspection occurrence entry, milestone reviews, business cycles, business cycle entry and inspection comparison) are carried from load_task_truth to project_semantic_views on the direct task_projection arc. Each contract carries a task read scope identifying projectKey, mode and taskId. The scoped task read resolves that declared project and mode from configuration and reads its own Journal inventory; it never borrows the serve-bound project's Coordinator, task snapshot or Organ identity.
meta.semanticScopeContract: GET /api/tasks/:id/semantic and /api/tasks/:id/semantic/stream accept an optional complete projectKey and mode pair. Omitting both keeps the legacy serve-bound live Coordinator read. A complete non-bound scope reads the declared project and mode Journal inventory and projects the same runtime semantic envelope from durable events. Both semantic paths carry the selected task snapshot's defined typed publicOutput publication (state plus commits with exact {ref, text}) and its publicCommitWatermark into the semantic envelope unchanged; commit order, text, refs and the two independent watermarks are preserved, and absence stays omitted and is never replaced by zero or the runtime sourceWatermark. A partial or invalid pair fails before streaming as read.scope.invalid; an unknown project fails as project.unknown; a task absent from that scope fails as task.not-found.
meta.observationScopeContract: GET /api/tasks/:id/observation accepts the same optional complete projectKey and mode pair. Omitting both keeps the synchronous serve-bound observation behavior. A complete scope resolves the declared project and mode before projection; a partial or invalid pair fails as read.scope.invalid, an unknown project as project.unknown, and an absent task as task.not-found. The scope query parameter is only the observation subtree ref, and node is only the selected node id.
meta.observationTruthContract: A scoped observation reads the task snapshot and admission history from the selected project/mode Journal, never from the serve-bound requirementAdmissions map. The task.output node uses only the authoritative committed public publication from the same scope. Missing, pending, unavailable or unknown publication stays explicit and is not replaced by record.output, provider text or model text; raw and action history remain available as evidence.
meta.observationAgentContract: The observation route decodes the existing agent, turn and item selection query with decodeTaskAgentActivitySelectionQuery. UiRuntimeService attaches readTaskAgentActivity from the same resolved project/mode source. It does not fabricate a bound Organ or borrow another project's Agent activity.
meta.foreignSemanticStreamContract: A non-bound durable semantic stream validates and reads its snapshot before writing the 200 text/event-stream headers, emits one semantic snapshot, then emits the transport event semantic-complete with empty JSON data and ends normally. It never subscribes to the serve-bound Coordinator. The completion event is a transport signal and does not alter the semantic payload or add business metadata.
meta.publicOutputContract: Durable task inventory restores record.publicOutput through the same FileCheckpointStore.readPublicOutputs reader used by the live coordinator. The binding keeps the task's business scope and selects the committed checkpoint execution epoch when the current operation has one, otherwise the operation allocation epoch. For a valid bound live read, App composes the captured Runtime publication state with the same-binding durable commits: a successful committed-record read does not clear a captured typed pending state, while commits, output text and publicCommitWatermark remain the durable values and no uncommitted text is exposed. A read failure remains visible as unknown with the current already retained commits and watermark. Semantic GET and SSE carry the same typed publication (state and commits with exact {ref, text}) and its defined publicCommitWatermark without filtering by publication state, so pending, unavailable or unknown retains any already confirmed commits and boundary. Missing publication leaves the semantic field absent. The read never falls back to record.output and never fabricates success.

terminalContract.failure: explicit stale/disconnected/unmapped projection; no raw inference or fake live state
terminalContract.blocked: scope, semantic coverage, project or agent identity unavailable is explicit
terminalContract.cleanup: read-only projection closes with no runtime mutation
